title: Surface a role slot's optional description in the preamble roles line and cells-add help
action: Add optional per-role description display: model_guard.rs renders name=model ("desc") in the dispatch-door roles line when the raw slot object carries a non-empty description string; catalog.rs cells-add help gains one sentence naming models.<rt>.<role>.description as the place to document a role's purpose (then bee dev regen); status_full/store.rs gains a validator test proving description-carrying slot shapes yield zero problems.
verify: cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee model_guard session_preamble status_full — green, including a new test asserting a described role renders name=model ("desc") and an existing-config test asserting byte-identical output without descriptions; bee dev regen leaves the tree clean.
judge_obligation_ack: display-only change to dispatch_door_lines/role_slot_display rendering plus help text; the guard's deny/allow logic is untouched, and the new tests assert the no-description output stays byte-identical
notes: PBI p-a1399c00. (1) model_guard.rs role_slot_display/dispatch_door_lines: when the raw slot value is an object carrying a non-empty string `description`, render the role as name=model ("desc") — desc trimmed, truncated to 60 chars with an ellipsis; string/null slots and objects without the key render exactly as today. (2) catalog.rs cells add help: one sentence noting a role's purpose may be documented as models.<rt>.<role>.description in .bee/config.json and the session preamble lists it; run bee dev regen after. (3) status_full/store.rs: no behavior change — add a validator test proving a `description` key on each documented object slot shape ({model}, {kind:native}, {kind:cli}, {kind:herding}, composite) yields zero problems. (4) Tests: extend model_guard/session_preamble tests with a described role asserting the rendered line, and assert existing no-description lines are byte-identical. Resolution, guard, and dispatch prepare must not read the field.
